description: The contract explicitly defines behavior when the input collection or string is empty.
The contract explicitly permits or rejects numeric values with plus or minus signs.
The contract explicitly defines an inclusive range whose first endpoint is below its second.
The contract explicitly defines a range whose first endpoint is above its second.
The contract explicitly defines whitespace around values, separators, or fields.
The contract requires duplicate results to be removed while preserving first appearance.
The contract explicitly requires malformed, missing, or empty segments to be rejected.
The contract explicitly rejects integers outside the language's safe integer domain.
The contract explicitly compares or keys textual values without regard to letter case.
The contract requires output to retain a defined input or insertion order.
The contract explicitly defines behavior when a requested key does not exist.
The contract explicitly defines behavior for overlapping or concurrent operations.
